title: Parenting interventions to promote early child development in the first three years of life: A global systematic review and meta-analysis
shortTitle: 早期养育干预：全球证据
author: Joshua Jeong；Emily E. Franchett；Clariana V. Ramos de Oliveira；Karima Rehmani；Aisha K. Yousafzai
summary: 汇总33国102项随机试验：早期养育干预整体改善儿童发展和亲子互动，但多数试验只支持母亲，不能等同于父亲专门干预。
